# Vitalii Popov — Full-Stack Engineer

> Personal portfolio, CV, and engineering case studies for Vitalii Popov — a full-stack engineer specializing in distributed systems and AI. Lives in Berlin, Germany. Open to roles across Germany, the EU, UK, US, UAE, Canada, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, and Australia.

## About

Vitalii Popov is a full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience building systems that create measurable business value across e-commerce, mobility, and AI domains.

**Current role:** Full-Stack Developer at Infineon Technologies AG (09/2024–present)
**Education:** M.Sc. Web Engineering, Chemnitz University of Technology (in progress); B.Sc. Software Engineering, Higher School of Economics, Moscow

## Key Achievements

- Replaced a €480K/year commercial parking guidance vendor with an in-house system at Infineon (8,000 users, 3,000 monthly active)
- Built a Go microservice searching 200M+ warehouse items in under 5 seconds at OZON Tech
- Saved €86K with a C# barcode-scanner integration at OZON Tech
- Increased key SEO/UX metrics by 11.63% at onlineTours through A/B testing
- Shipped 9 client products at WeDo.agency, from AI tools to e-commerce platforms
- Technical articles with 5,000+ combined views across Habr, Dev.to, and Medium

## Core Stack

Backend: Go, Python, C#, Node.js, Ruby on Rails
Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, Docker Registry
AI/ML: RAG, Qdrant, Embedding Models, LangChain, Ollama, MCP Server, Context Engineering, Hugging Face, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot
Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka
